notes.title: Post Pax Pandemonium
notes.content:
Hi guys! It was awesome meeting so many of you at PAX Aus! We had a blast, and we hope you did too! Here’s a quick look at some pics we took of your lovely faces enjoying the game:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35884391/05b9130987fc3f1d1ac4273a7e8bb1a7cdae6fab.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35884391/ecf62ac0cd7a3cac692b346d2ab73911419716aa.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35884391/52f186c0fff5e8c7b3bdd35138533ef94bbf23de.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35884391/8e1a132848e29cddcb212b0f25d3e2cf2fd356ee.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35884391/bf4aab4ec356ab9b19bb1b429f2103b6df1d38d6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35884391/a9875a878e0544540d48de14f0f45263ff368fc7.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35884391/0d61e37889135ee88146c3854adc68540b349c34.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35884391/b6e649375cf624c1e4dc637f25fc922636e1d527.jpg[/img][/url]

Whew! Now that that’s out of the way…
[h1]What’s on the Horizon (aka happening in the next month):[/h1]
This month we have a few goals to achieve. The first one is completing the desert level so it is available to test when the beta comes around. This will involve creating a few extra desert themed environments, and finalizing a tile layout. We currently have one variation sorted for it 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35884391/adc0af588ad49ab8bb4d8ef91c1fbe4944e313ac.png[/img]
[i]Mmmm check out that desert-y goodness[/i]


We will add a few more and tweak a few things to spice it up. 

[b]Menu overhaul[/b]
Our menus are functional…. but not the prettiest. We will be doing an overhaul to make them easy to use and look nice. This will include the win screen!

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
We found a few bugs during our PAX experience (getting stuck and turning into a turret anyone?) so they will be at the top of our “to fix“ list. We will also be adding the ‘X‘ button as jump since it was such a highly requested addition!

[b]And that about wraps things up. Thank you to everyone who came and tried Sprocket Rocket Rumble out, it was truly awesome to see so many people having a good time with the game![/b]
